scope: Read-only comparison of six changed Valve hero responses against every current playable question in the launch index.

referencingPlayableQuestions.prompt: Which hero owns this ability?
referencingPlayableQuestions.explanation:
Switch Discipline belongs to Kez. Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.

referencingPlayableQuestions.prompt: Whose upgrade is this?
referencingPlayableQuestions.explanation: Earthshaker's Aghanim's Shard upgrades Fissure. Casting another ability releases a shorter stun along an existing terrain barrier.

referencingPlayableQuestions.prompt: Whose upgrade is this?
referencingPlayableQuestions.explanation: Invoker's Aghanim's Scepter upgrades Ice Wall. Turns a wall spell into a vector-targeted strip that roots enemies who remain inside long enough.

referencingPlayableQuestions.prompt: Whose upgrade is this?
referencingPlayableQuestions.explanation: Kez's Aghanim's Shard upgrades Shodo Sai. A successful parry creates a stronger mark that adds stun duration and critical damage.

verdict: No current playable answer, condition, hint, or explanation needs a change for these six hero-response deltas.
evidence: Freezing Field still has 100 explosions at 0.1 second intervals. The renamed fields do not change the value. The only playable reference is a Soundcheck distractor.

Fissure loses an internal free-pathing radius field. The current Shard question asks about the shorter Aftershock stun, and the current Valve Shard text still confirms that effect. It contains no pathing or radius claim.
No current playable question refers to Plague Ward. Its health and displayed damage values are unchanged, and its description already states magic immunity.
All 17 behavior-only changes add exactly bit 2^53 and preserve every previous bit. Names, owners, descriptions, upgrades, damage, mana and cooldown fields are unchanged.

Current numeric answers remain Tornado cooldown 27, Talon Toss maximum damage 240 and level-one mana 60, Hotfeet Hustle level-one mana 25 and maximum mana 45, Chaos Meteor mana 200, and Sun Strike mana 175. All eight ranking questions still use these values.
The current Invoker Ice Wall Scepter and Kez Shodo Sai Shard descriptions still support their upgrade questions.
Sound identity and distractor labels do not depend on the changed numeric or behavior fields.
limits: No semantics are assigned to the new internal behavior bit. No playable question asks about that bit. This comparison does not claim live-client execution or audio revalidation.
